title: VEA, QWLD: Big ETF Inflows
text:
VEA, QWLD: Big ETF Inflows Thursday, January 11, 10:48 AM ET 10 Best Performing ETFs » Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF (AMEX: VEA ), which added 10,500,000 units, or a 0.7% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of VEA, in morning trading today Nestle ( NSRGY ) is off about 0.6%, and Novartis (NYSE: NVS ) is lower by about 0.4%. 
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the SPDR MSCI World StrategicFactors ETF (AMEX: QWLD ), which added 100,000 units, for a 33.3% increase in outstanding units. Among the largest underlying components of QWLD, in morning trading today Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is up about 0.4%, and Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ ) is higher by about 0.3%. 
For MarketNewsVideo.com, I'm Sayoko Murase.
